name: process-mining
description: Agent skills for process mining event logs with the pmx CLI

interface.shortDescription: Profile event logs and mine process models with pmx
interface.longDescription: Turn an event log - XES, gzipped XES, or a CSV of case, activity and timestamp rows - into an answer about how the process actually runs, using the pmx CLI over pm4py: case, activity and variant counts, case durations, the most common paths and how concentrated they are, exact directly-follows counts, and a mined Petri net or BPMN model rendered as an image, filtered to the frequent variants when the full model is unreadable, plus object-centric logs that have no single case id.
defaultPrompt: What does the process in this event log look like?
What are the most common paths through this log?
Mine a BPMN model from this log
